costs.scope: Observed incremental trial costs with existing Source/teacher caches; not standalone end-to-end inference latency

source_quality.definition: q is leave-self-out cached consistency, not GT quality or semantic-identity correctness. Commit permission additionally requires two other witnesses, positive external support delta and unchanged bank validity/activity.

config.bank: unchanged sealed box_propagation_hc64 three complete-box candidates
config.quality: 56 directed other-anchor WLS full-box and Source ROI matches; (incoming+outgoing)/14; no self-match
config.commit_gate: quality>=.1 and >=2 other mutual witnesses>=.1, active valid alternative and positive external support delta
config.state: E plus eight evidence-source commitments; hard write on admitted action; no EMA
config.reset: verified observed anchor clears conflicting committed source with mutual support<.1
config.Direct: same evidence and logits, differentiable exact mixture of hard transitions, full Q4 suffix probability and target gradients every inner step
config.OPD: two current hard student histories acquired each outer, Q4 feedback detached and reused ten steps
config.FixedKD: two initial teacher histories fixed, current Q4 feedback refreshed each outer and reused ten steps
config.feedback: Q4 under current student, rho=active*(delta_support+.25*(incoming_link-link_EE)-.1G); no commitment reward
config.acceptance: external additive trajectory utility nondecrease after each ten-step outer; reject restores raw and Adam; continue next outer
config.GT: offline only after all64 three-arm predictions and traces sealed
config.limitations: consistency is not semantic identity verification; correlated same-eight-frame teacher may agree on wrong instance; no guaranteed OPD advantage
